name: excalidraw-diagram
title_zh: 把想法画成可编辑的 Excalidraw 图表 JS
tagline_zh: 聊架构、理流程、讲概念时，直接产出可拖拽的图表文件。不用切画板、不用手动排版，对话结束图就绪。
tagline_en: Turn chat into a draggable Excalidraw diagram file. No tab-switching, no manual layout — the diagram is ready.
desc_en: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, or concepts.
why_zh: 生成的是原生 Excalidraw JSON，而非图片。每个节点、连线、文字都可再编辑。
why_en: Outputs native Excalidraw JSON, not an image. Every node, edge, and label stays editable, so you can drop it back onto your.
limit_zh: 只产出 JSON 文件，不负责渲染预览。若你的环境没有 Excalidraw 编辑器或查看器，拿到手只是一堆文本。
limit_en: Outputs JSON only, no preview rendering. Without an Excalidraw editor/viewer in your environment, you get raw text, not a visual diagram.
